scope: Independent read-only review of Rust release.rs and updater_release_cache.rs against the frozen public Go release/cache contracts and existing additive URL/timestamp evidence. Existing captured-row approval is bounded; general source compatibility, final gate, native transport and whole migration approval are separate.

zero_instant_source.observation: Frozen implementation requires both zero seconds and zero nanoseconds; the represented UTC instant is independent of location spelling.

assertion_review: All 159 representable original cases invoke the actual production constructor and Check with normal HttpTransport and ReleaseCache dependencies; they do not substitute a release/checker result.

Every one of the 15 original observation fields is compared: release, throttled, full error, complete single-cause error chain, canceled, deadline_error, trace, requests, bodies, cache_write_attempts, cache_after, cache_exists_after, cache_port_deadlines, probe_losers_canceled and now_calls.

All original cases have exactly the same 15 keys as the fixed Rust Observation struct. No currently captured expectation is removed, sorted, substring-matched, rewritten or excluded by the comparison.
One Go nil receiver is separately retained; Rust owned non-null receivers do not imply reproduction of a Go nil pointer.

The selected-release empty-asset projection to JSON null maps Go append-to-nil slice ownership. Exact cache bytes retain their original null versus empty-array spelling and are compared independently.

All 13 additive observations compare their complete captured error, error chain and attempted cache writes. Their expected data comes from the actual frozen Go constructor/Check source and a visible synthetic transport/cache probe.
captured_evidence_review.root_fullgate_input_snapshot_explanation: The original fullscript2 snapshot is deliberately immutable historical evidence and predates the zero-instant source/test delta. Its mismatch is historical, not an unsealed-current-source finding. The corrected fullscript3 snapshot was sealed after the delta and exactly matches the final reviewed source and test hashes; fullscript3 terminal results remain a separate root-owned gate.

review_observations: SemVer numeric components and numeric prerelease comparisons use decimal string length and bytes, avoiding fixed integer limits; build metadata is retained in text and ignored in precedence, and the first equal release wins.
Drafts and GitHub-labelled prereleases are skipped at the frozen boundaries; included malformed published tags fail instead of silently selecting an older release.

Cache/source/query selection and write use the same caller context or one total bounded automatic child deadline; explicit checks retain parent deadlines. No context check is added after successful cache Write.

Schema2 cached page identity and visited-page identity use canonical endpoint paths while request/cache URL query spelling remains distinct. Exact cached 304 identity, duplicate cached pages and cached next URL validation are preserved for reviewed rows.
A configured source selector is a normal production dependency. Only its first selected API source is used for every fetched page; there is no per-page source fallback.

Query decoding accepts the first JSON value and ignores same-read errors with positive byte counts according to the captured Go decoder boundary. Sequential Node fields preserve captured known-field duplicates, case folding and null retention; body Close errors are ignored after the reviewed request/decode/status paths.
limitations: Existing PageUrl parsing, raw-byte unescaping, JSON syntax diagnostics and cache time parsing are bounded mappings, not complete Go net/url, encoding/json or time grammar implementations.
Invalid caller RawRead byte counts, arbitrary I/O errors, future-drop schedules and concurrent reads/closes are not generalized from the synthetic valid-reader observations.
Synthetic HTTP adapters do not prove native DNS/TLS/proxy/default-client URL grammar, physical cancellation, public-source timing or service availability.
The three-second blocked-cache-read witness and deadline identities do not establish every physical transport/cache scheduler boundary.
File-cache atomic replacement, ACLs, syscall failures and native Windows/Darwin or six-platform runtime are outside these two reviewed files and remain separate obligations.
Pending Rust source-probe futures may be dropped while Go goroutines can continue; arbitrary delayed loser/body-close lifecycle is explicitly not broad equivalence.
No denied supplemental multiplex, unfinished-HEAD or upload probe was retried.
approval_conditions: Bounded source/focused approval binds the final source/test/oracle hashes above and the retained initial finding plus its resolved revision.
The exact-zero-instant blocker is resolved for all eight reviewed Go-first public Check observations, with unchanged prior160+13 expectations.
Required root-owned fullscript3, final whole-candidate input preservation and whole-updater review remain separate and are not certified here.
Any source or oracle change requires renewed review of affected scope.
No verified-platform promotion, full migration claim, commit, push, release publication or new native/external probe is authorized by this review.

unresolved_blocking_findings.finding: read_cache classifies missing checked_at using date.year()==1 and second-resolution Unix timestamp only. Frozen Go checks Time.IsZero, which requires the exact UTC zero instant including nanoseconds and is independent of local year.

examples.current_rust_semantics: rejected as missing_checked_at because nanoseconds are omitted

examples.frozen_go_semantics: the zero UTC instant, so missing_checked_at rejection occurs
examples.current_rust_semantics: accepted as nonmissing because the local year is zero
